title: Nutty Glassy-Jelly Brazilian Oreo Cream Biscuits Bake
description: A unique and adventurous Brazilian dessert featuring nutty and glassy-jelly elements with crushed Oreo cream biscuits, steamed to perfection. This Jain-friendly dessert is perfect for a special occasion or a weekend treat.
instructions: Combine crushed Oreo cream biscuits, cashews, and dates in a bowl to create a crunchy base.
Add coconut oil, brown sugar, and maple syrup to the bowl and mix until well combined.
In a separate bowl, whisk together baking soda and salt. Add to the wet ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Divide the dough into 8 equal portions and shape into small balls.
Steam the dough balls over boiling water for 12-15 minutes or until cooked through.
While the dough balls are steaming, prepare the glassy-jelly topping by combining coconut oil, brown sugar, and cornstarch in a saucepan.
Cook the glassy-jelly topping over medium heat, stirring constantly, until it thickens and turns a deep amber color.
Remove the dough balls from the steamer and let cool for a few minutes.
Dip each dough ball into the glassy-jelly topping, coating completely.
Place the coated dough balls on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and sprinkle with black sesame seeds.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 10-12 minutes or until golden brown.
Allow the biscuits to cool completely before serving.
